name: Jewel Magic Xmas
author: Addicting Games
description: Jewel Magic X-mas is a free clicker game. You're about to learn what the magic in x-mas is all about: jewels and matching three! Jewel Magic Xmas is a fast-movie holiday-themed match-three game and it is also filled with the reason for the season. Test your ability to recognize patterns and open yourself up to the world of combos' bonus points and extended blasts of match-three play. Whether you're matching jewels, bulbs, ornaments, candy canes, cookies, or glasses of eggnog, you can be sure that Jewel Magic X-mas is the game for you. So, whether you have decided to play this jewel matching game on your desktop computer or on your mobile device you can rest assured that you'll be able to point and click, or tap and swipe your way to the top of the heap in this exciting and fast-paced game of jewels, of magic, and of x-mas.
